label: Production V1.2.3
releaseNotes: Every LEIE server upload now defaults to /in/manual_process/ while referral uploads retain /CCRA_Uploads.
Switching workflows updates standard upload defaults without replacing a custom remote directory.
Updated the LEIE database validation SQL to include the latest batch-log lookup and all requested sanction-table checks.
The LEIE Validation SQL box now uses SQL syntax colors for keywords, values, numbers, and comments while remaining selectable and copyable.
LEIE Output File Name now defaults to the original source file name without adding a Processed_ prefix.
LEIE SFTP uploads now verify the remote file size before marking each server complete.
A stalled SFTP disconnect can no longer leave the upload permanently in progress or prevent the next selected server from running.
If one LEIE upload target fails, the app continues through the remaining selected targets and reports the failed server.
New in V1.2: LEIE Data Processing is a new feature in this release.
New in V1.2: LEIE processing now includes a built-in LEIE Upload and Validation Guide with copy-ready SQL checks.
Added LEIE Step 4 and Step 5 validation guidance in the Upload area for database and CCRS UI verification.
Security updates: upload settings are only activated after Import To Config, and WinSCP.ini handling/storage was hardened.
Bug fixes for LEIE scan flow, release update visibility, and upload target enable/disable behavior.
Upload target toggles are disabled until 'Upload the .gz file after processing' is selected.
Station IDs now remain exactly as selected, with an optional random mode restricted to valid reference entries.
Referral Numbers and ICNs can now match their final 3, 4, or 5 characters.
SSN and DOB values are randomized per patient by default, with fixed overrides still available.
SEOC Number and SEOC ID can now be selected as synchronized reference pairs.
Runtime and packaging dependencies were upgraded to Electron 43, electron-builder 26.15, and SheetJS 0.20.3.
